name: Overexcitation protection
summary: Supervises the voltage-to-frequency relationship associated with magnetic overexcitation.
description: Supervises the voltage-to-frequency relationship associated with magnetic overexcitation.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the VT inputs and frequency reference. The associated drawing should trace the transformer or generator protection output; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.

distinction: A voltage-to-frequency element differs from overvoltage 59 because frequency changes affect its criterion.
